sentences.en: One of the inevitable aspects of this decade, I think, of simply being human, is that there will come a time when we consciously and deliberately
sentences.zh: 我认为，这个十年——或者说作为人类——不可避免的一个方面是，总有一天我们需要有意识、有目的地

sentences.en: need to separate and move on from somebody that we once loved, whether that is a friend or an ex, somebody else in our lives, a family member, for example.
sentences.zh: 与曾经爱过的人分开并继续前行，无论是朋友、前任，还是生活中的其他人，比如家庭成员。

sentences.en: I think it is one of those really sad universal truths of kind of humanity.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是人性中一个非常悲伤的普遍真理。

sentences.en: Not all relationships are meant to laSt.

sentences.en: Not all of them can kind of withstand the test of time.
sentences.zh: 并非所有的关系都能经受住时间的考验。

sentences.en: And in order for us to really truly move on, sometimes we do need a total break from that person to fully heal and to finally process what we experienced.
sentences.zh: 为了真正地继续前行，有时我们需要与那个人彻底断绝联系，才能完全治愈并最终消化我们的经历。

sentences.en: Relationships, they break.
sentences.zh: 关系会破裂。

sentences.en: They fall apart.
sentences.zh: 它们会分崩离析。

sentences.en: And I think whilst we may have imagined that this person would have been in our life forever, maybe we always knew it was going to end this way,
sentences.zh: 我想，虽然我们可能曾幻想过这个人会永远留在我们的生命中，或者也许我们一直都知道它会以这种方式结束，

sentences.en: the conclusion of a relationship is a really messy and confusing time.
sentences.zh: 但一段关系的终结是一个非常混乱和令人困惑的时期。

sentences.en: And sometimes the only way forward, the only way to stop getting drawn back in, to stop compulsively checking on them, to allow yourself closure, is to go no contact.
sentences.zh: 有时，唯一的前进方式，唯一能阻止自己被再次卷入、阻止自己强迫性地查看对方、让自己获得解脱的方法，就是“断联”。

sentences.en: No contact, this method of separating ourselves and cutting off all kind of communication with
sentences.zh: “断联”，这种在分手、争吵或冲突后，与某人分离并切断所有沟通的方法，

sentences.en: somebody post-breakup, post-argument, post-conflict, it's really seen a rise in popularity and a rise in supporters.
sentences.zh: 近年来确实越来越受欢迎，支持者也越来越多。

sentences.en: And I want to talk about it today.
sentences.zh: 今天我想聊聊这个话题。

sentences.en: What exactly is no contact?
sentences.zh: 到底什么是断联？

sentences.en: What are the rules?
sentences.zh: 规则是什么？

sentences.en: How does it actually work?
sentences.zh: 它实际上是如何运作的？

sentences.en: Why is it so effective?
sentences.zh: 为什么它如此有效？

sentences.en: Why is it necessary?

sentences.en: And how can we actually stay committed to how, I guess, commitment to seeing this person fade from our lives and fade from our future?
sentences.zh: 我们该如何坚定地承诺，让这个人从我们的生活中、从我们的未来中淡出？

sentences.en: It's a really sad and scary reality that, you know, there might come a time where this person
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常悲伤且可怕的现实，你知道，可能有一天，这个人

sentences.en: just can't be the person that we want them to be and we do need to let ourselves and let them move on.
sentences.zh: 再也无法成为我们想要的样子，我们确实需要放过自己，也让他们继续前行。

sentences.en: So this is kind of your ultimate guide to no contact, how it works, why it works and how you can implement it.
sentences.zh: 所以，这算是你的断联终极指南：它如何运作，为什么有效，以及你该如何实施。

sentences.en: Now, I will say some people don't necessarily agree with me when I say that no contact is the answer.
sentences.zh: 当然，我得说，当我提到断联是解决之道时，有些人并不一定同意我的观点。

sentences.en: In fact, I think I would have previously disagreed with myself.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我想我以前也会不同意现在的自己。

sentences.en: If you had asked me two years ago whether you could stay in touch with an ex or repair a severely broken bond with a friend, I would have said yes.
sentences.zh: 如果你两年前问我是否可以和前任保持联系，或者修复一段严重破裂的友谊，我会说可以。

sentences.en: I would have said that that is the mature thing to do, that it showed growth.

sentences.en: It sounds insane.

sentences.en: It's still up if you want to go and find it.

sentences.en: But we essentially discussed how we were still friends, how we were so mature for maintaining the relationship.
sentences.zh: 但我们当时主要讨论的是我们如何保持朋友关系，以及我们为了维持这段关系表现得多么成熟。

sentences.en: Surprise, surprise, we no longer are.

sentences.en: And I think no contact was the way that that inevitably came to an end.
sentences.zh: 我认为断联是那段关系最终走向终结的方式。

sentences.en: Different things obviously work for different people.
sentences.zh: 显然，不同的人适用不同的方法。

sentences.en: But I think with relationships and with exes in particular, one of the reasons that we stay in touch, that we don't go no contact is because we aren't actually completely ready

sentences.en: When we keep giving people second chances, when we hope that they will change, when we let them overstep boundaries, eventually we do have to make a tough decision and hopefully
sentences.zh: 当我们不断给别人第二次机会，当我们希望他们会改变，当我们让他们越界时，最终我们必须做出一个艰难的决定，希望

sentences.zh: 但我个人认为，随着我越来越成熟，我越发理解，特别是在一段非常激烈、严肃的分手之后，找到解脱的

sentences.en: The more that I've kind of realized that no contact, when it's possible, when there are no kids or pets involved or you're not working together, whatever it is, no contact is the

sentences.en: So no contact is this kind of realization that we have that there needs to be a final and very much resolute separation from this person.
sentences.zh: 所以，断联是我们的一种觉悟，意识到需要与这个人进行最后且非常坚决的分离。

sentences.en: Now, when I say cutting off all contact, we are not just talking about, you know, avoiding running into them or blocking their number, their social media, their email.
sentences.zh: 现在，当我提到切断所有联系时，我们指的不仅仅是避免偶遇，或者拉黑他们的电话、社交媒体和电子邮件。

sentences.en: We are also talking about something that is not often included, which is preventing yourself from following up with mutual friends.
sentences.zh: 我们还谈到了一件经常被忽略的事情，那就是阻止自己去打听共同朋友的消息。

sentences.en: I think we often tend to focus on specifically the communication between just us and this one other person.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们往往倾向于只关注我们与这一个人之间的直接沟通。

sentences.en: And when we limit that, we are going no contact.
sentences.zh: 当我们限制了那种沟通，我们就做到了断联。

sentences.en: But the purpose of this method is to essentially allow somebody else to fade from your life in the most efficient way possible to put up that strong boundary.
sentences.zh: 但这种方法的目的是让某人以最高效的方式从你的生活中淡出，建立起那道坚固的界限。

sentences.en: And when we keep asking people around us if they've heard anything, if they know what's going on in that other person's life, you know, whether they're dating anybody, whether
sentences.zh: 而当我们不断询问周围的人是否听到过什么消息，是否知道那个人生活中的近况，比如他们是否在约会，是否

sentences.en: they're sad or they miss us, touching base with our mutual friends about their existence and their well-being and their whereabouts.
sentences.zh: 感到难过，或者是否想念我们，通过共同朋友去了解他们的存在、近况和行踪，

sentences.en: I think that really defeats the purpose.
sentences.zh: 我认为这真的违背了初衷。

sentences.en: It can also really undo so much of the effort that we've already put into Detach, right?
sentences.zh: 它也可能真的抵消了我们为了“脱离”所付出的巨大努力，对吧？

sentences.en: You know, we've done all the other things correctly.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们已经正确地做了所有其他事情。

sentences.en: We don't have any direct contact with this person, but that indirect contact still counts.
sentences.zh: 我们与这个人没有任何直接联系，但那种间接联系依然算数。

sentences.en: It still activates all those old memories.
sentences.zh: 它依然会激活所有那些旧的记忆。

sentences.en: It still keeps the memory of this person very much active and present in your life.
sentences.zh: 它依然让这个人的记忆在你的生活中保持活跃和存在。

sentences.en: That doesn't mean that you, of course, have to remove anybody that has any connection to this person.
sentences.zh: 当然，这并不意味着你必须移除任何与此人有联系的人。

sentences.en: Otherwise, you risk falling into temptation.
sentences.zh: 否则，你可能会面临陷入诱惑的风险。

sentences.en: More so that I think we need to be conscious of the ways that we are replacing the direct contact that we crave with this, with our ex, with our old friend.
sentences.zh: 更多的是，我认为我们需要意识到，我们正在用什么方式来替代我们渴望的与前任或老朋友的直接联系。

sentences.en: We're replacing that direct contact with secondary contact.
sentences.zh: 我们正在用二次联系来替代那种直接联系。

sentences.en: And it's still fulfilling that main function and purpose, which is that we feel connected to them in some way.
sentences.zh: 它依然在发挥着核心功能和目的，即我们感到与他们以某种方式保持着连接。

sentences.en: It is such a crucial element that I think we often forget, myself included at times.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常关键的因素，我认为我们经常忘记，包括我自己有时也是。

sentences.en: I remember going like no contact with an ex maybe three years back, but I remained very much
sentences.zh: 我记得大约三年前曾与一位前任断联，但我依然非常

sentences.en: attached and I really clung on to the friendships that I had with his housemates and the friends that we had made together.
sentences.zh: 依恋，我紧紧抓住我和他的室友以及我们共同结识的朋友之间的友谊不放。

sentences.en: And I eventually really realized that I was using a lot of our interactions to speak about him rather than actually focus on the other person.
sentences.zh: 最终我真的意识到，我利用我们之间的大部分互动来谈论他，而不是真正专注于对方。

sentences.en: And the friendship that we had built independent of my ex.
sentences.zh: 以及我们建立的、独立于我前任之外的友谊。

sentences.en: One thing that I think we know about no contact is that it requires a whole lot of commitment.
sentences.zh: 关于“断联”，我认为我们都知道的一点是，它需要极大的决心。

sentences.en: It is not for the fainthearted.
sentences.zh: 这可不是胆小鬼能做到的。

sentences.en: Somebody actually said it to me this way the other day.
sentences.zh: 前几天有人确实是这样跟我说的。

sentences.en: No contact involves treating this other person as if they've died.
sentences.zh: 断联意味着要把对方当作已经去世的人来对待。

sentences.en: That is how intense it can be and the level of discipline that it can take.
sentences.zh: 这足以说明它有多么强烈，以及需要多强的自律。

sentences.en: Like you kind of have to imagine that even if you wanted to reach out, you couldn't.
sentences.zh: 就像你必须想象，即使你想联系对方，你也做不到。

sentences.en: And I also think that this way of seeing things, there is absolutely no possibility of communicating going forward, helps us justify our grief as well.
sentences.zh: 而且我也认为，这种看待事物的方式——即未来绝对没有任何沟通的可能——也有助于我们为自己的悲伤找到正当理由。

sentences.en: It stops us from feeling a lot of disenfranchised grief that we shouldn't be feeling sad, that we should be over it by now, that this isn't a big deal.
sentences.zh: 它能阻止我们产生许多不被认可的悲伤，比如觉得“我不该感到难过”、“我早该走出来了”、“这没什么大不了的”。

sentences.en: When we treat it like, no, this person is forever out of my life, we are allowed to really feel the pain that I think we should be feeling at the end of any relationship.
sentences.zh: 当我们把它当作“不，这个人永远离开了我的生活”来对待时，我们才被允许真正去感受在任何一段关系结束时都应该感受到的痛苦。

sentences.en: The level, though, of discipline and control that that takes and knowing how finite that decision will probably be is what keeps a lot of us from ever thinking that we could do it.
sentences.zh: 然而，这所需要的自律和控制力，以及意识到这个决定很可能是最终定局，正是让许多人不敢去想自己能否做到的原因。

sentences.en: From trying every other possible solution, trying to be friends before we finally get to that point where we know that there is no other option.
sentences.zh: 在最终意识到别无选择之前，我们尝试了所有其他可能的解决方案，尝试过做朋友。

sentences.en: I also think that it's super normal sometimes to go back and forth, right, to unblock their number and then block it again, to really fight the urge to reach out and then slip up
sentences.zh: 我也认为，有时反复横跳是非常正常的，对吧？比如解开对方的号码又重新拉黑，努力克制联系对方的冲动，然后又破功了，

sentences.en: and have to reinstitute that wall between you two human relationships, especially ones that
sentences.zh: 不得不重新在你俩之间筑起那道墙，尤其是当你们的人际关系

sentences.en: are so deep and passionate and emotional that they would require this amount of drastic action.
sentences.zh: 如此深厚、充满激情和情感，以至于需要采取这种激进的手段时。

sentences.en: They're complicated and they contain a lot of contradictory emotions.
sentences.zh: 它们很复杂，包含着许多矛盾的情绪。

sentences.en: Anger one minute, nostalgia the next, grief one day and joy and gratitude tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 这一分钟愤怒，下一分钟怀旧；今天悲伤，明天又感到快乐和感激。

sentences.en: So it can be very hard to stay strong.
sentences.zh: 所以要保持坚定是非常困难的。

sentences.en: It can be very hard to be committed to this decision because how you're feeling about the situation
sentences.zh: 要坚持这个决定非常难，因为你对现状的感受

sentences.en: right now might not be how you're feeling about it tomorrow when you miss this person beyond belief, beyond anything you have felt.
sentences.zh: 此刻可能和你明天想念对方时的感受完全不同，那种想念超乎想象，超过你感受过的任何事物。

sentences.en: But personally, I do think that this period of no contact is almost necessary to completely heal and mend.
sentences.zh: 但就我个人而言，我确实认为这段断联期对于彻底治愈和修复几乎是必要的。

sentences.en: It provides us with the emotional, mental, social and importantly, the physical space to
sentences.zh: 它为我们提供了情感、心理、社交，以及最重要的物理空间，来

sentences.en: A, actually process our experience with them, the good and the bad and B, come to terms with
sentences.zh: 第一，真正处理我们与他们的经历，无论是好的还是坏的；第二，接受

sentences.en: the reality that this person is no longer going to be part of our life in the same way and that is what it's going to be going forward.
sentences.zh: 这样一个现实：这个人将不再以同样的方式出现在我们的生活中，未来就是这样了。

sentences.en: That is something that we cannot change.
sentences.zh: 这是我们无法改变的事实。

sentences.en: If we have decided that we cannot be in a relationship with this person, if they've decided it for us, part of that future, that future path that we are now on is, you know, a path
sentences.zh: 如果我们已经决定不能再与这个人维持关系，或者如果他们替我们做了决定，那么我们现在所处的未来道路的一部分，你知道，就是一条

sentences.en: towards never speaking again.
sentences.zh: 通往永不再见的道路。

sentences.en: And I think no contact gets us comfortable with that reality a lot quicker.
sentences.zh: 我认为断联能让我们更快地适应这一现实。

sentences.en: Here's kind of how I like to see it and how I've justified it actually to myself in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 以下是我看待它的方式，以及我过去实际上是如何说服自己的。

sentences.en: The end of a relationship is always going to hurt.
sentences.zh: 一段关系的结束总是会带来痛苦。

sentences.en: The pain of detaching from someone is going to be intense no matter which way you square it.
sentences.zh: 无论你怎么权衡，与某人断开联系的痛苦都是强烈的。

sentences.en: But that pain can exist for a longer period of time, for a year or more, at like 50% intensity or it can exist at 100% intensity but only for a couple of months.
sentences.zh: 但这种痛苦可以以50%的强度持续更长时间，比如一年或更久；或者以100%的强度只持续几个月。

sentences.en: It really depends on whether you are ready to heal or endure the separation over a longer timeline or whether you are ready to bite the bullet.
sentences.zh: 这真的取决于你是准备好治愈并忍受长期的分离，还是准备好长痛不如短痛。

sentences.en: And yes, experience the intensity of all of that grief, all of that rage, all of that recovery at once rather than keeping yourself still kind of attached to them just because
sentences.zh: 是的，一次性体验所有那些悲伤、愤怒和恢复过程的强度，而不是仅仅因为

sentences.en: it makes it feel easier in the moment.
sentences.zh: 那样做在当下感觉更容易，就让自己依然依附于对方。

sentences.en: So my other argument for no contact is that it also stops us from sliding back into the relationship during that very vulnerable period where we do just genuinely want somebody.
sentences.zh: 所以我支持断联的另一个理由是，它还能阻止我们在那个非常脆弱的时期滑回这段关系中，因为那时我们确实真心渴望某个人。

sentences.en: And when that somebody is somebody that we are already familiar with and that we already know and that we know is available, it's so much easier to backslide.
sentences.zh: 而当那个人是我们已经熟悉、了解，并且知道对方“有空”时，就太容易重蹈覆辙了。

sentences.en: No contact is basically you saying, no, this is an absolute decision.
sentences.zh: 断联基本上就是你在说：不，这是一个绝对的决定。

sentences.en: And I think it's a lot harder for you to turn around and be like, no, just kidding, I changed my mind because you can't really justify that to your past version of yourself.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为你很难回头说“不，开个玩笑，我改变主意了”，因为你无法向过去的自己证明这一点。

sentences.en: You can't justify that to your current version of yourself who knows in the back of their mind that there was a reason that we decided to be this drastic about our efforts.
sentences.zh: 你也无法向现在的自己证明，因为你的潜意识里知道，我们决定采取如此激进的措施是有原因的。

sentences.en: So the final reason I think that no contact is powerful is because it lets us provide ourselves with closure rather than waiting on somebody else to do it for us.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为断联强大的最后一个原因是，它让我们能够自我了结，而不是等着别人来为我们做这件事。

sentences.en: It lets us essentially take matters into our own hands.
sentences.zh: 它本质上让我们把主动权掌握在自己手中。

sentences.en: If this person is still stringing you along, you know, hitting you up every now and again, if you're still waiting for a message or relying on them when you know that you can't,
sentences.zh: 如果这个人还在吊着你，你知道，时不时联系你一下；如果你还在等消息，或者在明知不能依赖他们时却依然依赖他们，

sentences.en: no contact gives you the power to close that chapter for yourself.
sentences.zh: 断联给了你为自己翻开新篇章的力量。

sentences.en: It is such a decisive and strong way of saying, I'm done.
sentences.zh: 这是一种非常果断且有力的方式，意味着：我受够了。

sentences.en: I'm over this, like this is done.
sentences.zh: 我走出来了，这事儿结束了。

sentences.en: And I have made that decision for both of us.
sentences.zh: 而且我已经为我们俩做出了这个决定。

sentences.en: I am putting all of the memories, our bond, our love that is now in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 我正在把所有的记忆、我们的羁绊、我们的爱，都封存在过去。

sentences.en: And my future is just kind of me, myself and I, and I'm going to move forward without you beside me.
sentences.zh: 我的未来只有我一个人，我将独自前行，不再有你相伴。

sentences.en: I think it's also especially powerful for breaking really painful and toxic cycles of like distancing
sentences.zh: 我认为它在打破那种痛苦且有毒的循环方面也特别有效，比如

sentences.en: ourselves for a couple of weeks and then going back because no contact is quite permanent, right?
sentences.zh: 疏远几周然后又复合，因为断联是相当永久的，对吧？

sentences.en: It's really saying enough is enough.
sentences.zh: 这真的是在说：适可而止。

sentences.en: That's it.
sentences.zh: 就这样。

sentences.en: I'm doing what is best for me.
sentences.zh: 我正在做对我最好的事。

sentences.en: It is a hard boundary rather than like a soft permission slip of like, maybe if you like text me at 2am, this could be a thing.
sentences.zh: 这是一个硬性界限，而不是像“如果你凌晨两点给我发短信，也许我们还能怎样”这种软性的许可。

sentences.en: It's like, no, you can't even text me.
sentences.zh: 这就像是：不，你连短信都不能发给我。

sentences.en: This is not even a remote possibility.
sentences.zh: 这甚至连一丝可能性都没有。

sentences.en: So why does this work?
sentences.zh: 那么为什么这招有效呢？

sentences.en: So many people, including myself, obviously are such huge proponents of this method for really detaching and finally ending things.
sentences.zh: 很多人，包括我自己，显然都非常推崇这种真正脱离关系并最终结束一切的方法。

sentences.en: There has to be some evidence for it.
sentences.zh: 它一定有一些证据支持。

sentences.en: There has to be more than just anecdotal evidence that this is effective and efficient.
sentences.zh: 它一定不仅仅是轶事证据，而是确实有效且高效的。

sentences.en: Of course, I had to find the science for you guys.
sentences.zh: 当然，我必须为你们找到科学依据。

sentences.en: Couldn't just give you empty advice without the psychology.
sentences.zh: 不能在没有心理学支撑的情况下给你们空洞的建议。

sentences.en: So to understand this, we really need to comprehend the psychology and the biology of attachment.
sentences.zh: 所以要理解这一点，我们真的需要理解依恋的心理学和生物学。

sentences.en: And it starts with how we initially fell in love with this person.
sentences.zh: 这始于我们最初爱上这个人的方式。

sentences.en: So when we begin to get close to someone, especially intimately, whether that is emotional, physical intimacy, even in like intellectual intimacy, our brain releases oxytocin.
sentences.zh: 当我们开始与某人亲近时，尤其是亲密关系，无论是情感、身体上的亲密，甚至是智力上的亲密，我们的大脑都会释放催产素。

sentences.en: This is known as the love or the bonding hormone.
sentences.zh: 这被称为“爱情荷尔蒙”或“结合荷尔蒙”。

sentences.en: And the function of this hormone is to promote trust, to promote safety, security.
sentences.zh: 这种荷尔蒙的功能是促进信任，促进安全感和保障感。

sentences.en: And it's really crucial.
sentences.zh: 它非常关键。

sentences.en: It is like the biological building block for asserting and creating and constructing relationships.
sentences.zh: 它就像是建立、创造和构建人际关系的生物学基石。

sentences.en: So it's kind of what binds a lot of us together.
sentences.zh: 所以它在某种程度上把我们很多人联系在了一起。

sentences.en: The other thing to know about oxytocin is that it is often released in tandem and parallel
sentences.zh: 关于催产素，另一件需要知道的事是，它通常与我们联想到的

sentences.en: to other hormones and neurotransmitters that we associate with pleasure and happiness and love.
sentences.zh: 快乐、幸福和爱相关的其他荷尔蒙和神经递质同步释放。

sentences.en: I'm talking about dopamine and serotonin.
sentences.zh: 我说的是多巴胺和血清素。

sentences.en: Of course, the two famous ones.
sentences.zh: 当然，这是两种著名的物质。

sentences.en: There have been some studies, including one published in 2017, that suggests that the chemical reaction produced by this cocktail of hormones and chemicals and neurotransmitters
sentences.zh: 有一些研究，包括2017年发表的一项研究表明，由这种荷尔蒙、化学物质和神经递质鸡尾酒产生的化学反应，

sentences.en: that is associated with falling in love is a lot similar to the same chemical process that occurs when we become addicted to a substance.
sentences.zh: 与我们对某种物质上瘾时发生的化学过程非常相似。

sentences.en: It's thrilling.
sentences.zh: 它令人兴奋。

sentences.en: It's exhilarating.
sentences.zh: 它令人振奋。

sentences.en: It, you know, consumes our rational brain and it gets us hooked.
sentences.zh: 你知道，它占据了我们的理性大脑，让我们上瘾。

sentences.en: Not only is oxytocin just a really nice hormone to experience, not only does it make us feel really good, it is also habit forming.
sentences.zh: 催产素不仅是一种体验起来非常美妙的荷尔蒙，不仅让我们感觉良好，它还会让人形成习惯。

sentences.en: Because it is such a pleasurable experience, when the release of oxytocin is paired with some event or stimuli or a person, like an ex-boyfriend, an ex-girlfriend, an ex-partner,
sentences.zh: 因为它是一种如此愉悦的体验，当催产素的释放与某个事件、刺激或某个人（比如前男友、前女友、前伴侣）挂钩时，

sentences.en: we begin to associate this person with all of those amazing feelings that we are chasing.
sentences.zh: 我们开始将这个人与我们所追求的所有美妙感觉联系起来。

sentences.en: And so when we want a hit of that same great feeling, we seek them out.
sentences.zh: 所以当我们想要那种美妙感觉的“一剂猛药”时，我们就会去寻找他们。

sentences.en: They kind of become like our drug dealer.
sentences.zh: 他们有点像我们的毒贩。

sentences.en: All of this is what contributes to the intensity of the early stages of a relationship, but also like the comfort and the warmth of love.
sentences.zh: 所有这些都促成了关系初期的强烈程度，也促成了爱的舒适和温暖。

sentences.en: Now, when things start to turn sour, it is not like that love fades overnight.
sentences.zh: 现在，当事情开始变质时，这种爱并不会一夜之间消失。

sentences.en: What we start to see is, I think, a general gradual decline, but also an unstable association between all of those nice feelings and that person, but also a new set of feelings.
sentences.zh: 我们开始看到的是，我认为，一种普遍的逐渐衰退，以及那些美好感觉与那个人之间不稳定的联系，同时也伴随着一系列新的感受。

sentences.en: Feelings of sadness, feelings of worry, feelings of longing, despair, unfulfillment.
sentences.zh: 悲伤、担忧、渴望、绝望、未被满足的感觉。

sentences.en: And so we don't really know whether this next interaction we have with them is going to produce the feelings that we want to be having,
sentences.zh: 所以我们真的不知道与他们的下一次互动是否会产生我们想要的感受，

sentences.en: which is the feelings of love, or the feelings that make us distressed and feeling rejected and uncomfortable.
sentences.zh: 即爱的感觉，还是会让我们感到痛苦、被拒绝和不舒服的感受。

sentences.en: Despite that, it might not be all bad, right?
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，情况可能并不全是坏的，对吧？

sentences.en: It's just that there is this, that the bad experiences begin to outweigh the positive ones.
sentences.zh: 只是坏的经历开始超过积极的经历。

sentences.en: That's often what leads to a breakup.
sentences.zh: 这通常是导致分手的原因。

sentences.en: But it doesn't mean that there isn't still like a baseline of feeling.
sentences.zh: 但这并不意味着依然没有一种基准的情感存在。

sentences.en: There is obviously going to be like a maintaining level of positive neurological and biological reactions going, you know, going about below the surface,
sentences.zh: 显然，在表面之下，依然会有一种维持水平的积极神经和生物反应在进行，

sentences.en: even if they are not the majority.
sentences.zh: 即使它们不是主流。

sentences.en: There is still some part of us that remains attached and bonded to this person, even if things, you know, start to become shaky because we have that history.
sentences.zh: 我们内心依然有一部分与这个人保持着依恋和羁绊，即使事情开始变得动摇，因为我们有那段历史。

sentences.en: So when we break up, when we realize that this person is not for us, or when they break up with us, perhaps out of the blue, perhaps we didn't want it to occur,
sentences.zh: 所以当我们分手时，当我们意识到这个人不适合我们时，或者当他们突然提出分手，也许我们并不希望它发生时，

sentences.en: on a conscious level, we kind of know that things have obviously changed.
sentences.zh: 在意识层面，我们知道事情显然已经改变了。

sentences.en: Like we were present for this experience.
sentences.zh: 就像我们亲身经历了这一切。

sentences.en: We are feeling distressed, but our neurotransmitters don't know that.
sentences.zh: 我们感到痛苦，但我们的神经递质不知道这一点。

sentences.en: Our dopamine receptors don't know that.
sentences.zh: 我们的多巴胺受体不知道这一点。

sentences.en: And so it's not like the tap is suddenly turned off for our brain.
sentences.zh: 所以大脑并不是突然就把水龙头关掉了。

sentences.en: It's not like the moment we've broken up with somebody, or the moment a relationship has ended,
sentences.zh: 并不是说我们与某人分手的瞬间，或者关系结束的瞬间，

sentences.en: our brain goes, all right, let's just shut all that down and get them back to normal.
sentences.zh: 我们的大脑就会说：“好了，把这一切都关掉，让他们恢复正常吧。”

sentences.en: What is happening is that there is still this urge and this craving and this desire
sentences.zh: 正在发生的是，依然存在这种冲动、渴望和欲望，

sentences.en: for the kind of positive, happy chemicals and hormones that this person was previously eliciting, but there is no longer a catalyst for those reactions
sentences.zh: 想要这个人之前激发的那些积极、快乐的化学物质和荷尔蒙，但这些反应已经没有催化剂了，

sentences.en: because this person is no longer in your life.
sentences.zh: 因为这个人已经不在你的生活中了。

sentences.en: That is part of why breakups are so painful, because the urge to stay connected to this person
sentences.zh: 这就是分手如此痛苦的部分原因，因为想要与这个人保持联系的冲动，

sentences.en: is still being triggered by our craving and our desire for all these good experiences.
sentences.zh: 依然被我们对所有这些美好体验的渴望和欲望所触发。

sentences.en: And it's also still being triggered because we have probably formed a whole series of habits and behaviors around seeking love out from this individual.
sentences.zh: 而且它依然被触发，是因为我们可能已经围绕着从这个人身上寻求爱，形成了一系列习惯和行为。

sentences.en: That's really why in the weeks and the early months after a breakup, after the end of a relationship,
sentences.zh: 这确实就是为什么在分手后的几周和最初几个月里，

sentences.en: it's especially hard because we are essentially rewiring our brain to not need them anymore.
sentences.zh: 情况特别艰难，因为我们本质上是在重塑大脑，让它不再需要他们。

sentences.en: Here's the catch though.
sentences.zh: 但问题来了。

sentences.en: Anytime you reach out, you get that spike again.
sentences.zh: 每当你联系对方，你就会再次获得那种刺激。

sentences.en: When you see them out in public, you are immediately transported back into how great it felt.
sentences.zh: 当你在公共场合看到他们时，你立刻被带回了那种美妙的感觉中。

sentences.en: And so you are getting just enough to maintain those previous neural pathways that were kind of formed in like the era of your love story.
sentences.zh: 所以你得到的刺激刚好足以维持那些在你们爱情故事时代形成的神经通路。

sentences.en: Those connections are still maintained by those small text messages that you sometimes get.
sentences.zh: 那些联系依然靠你偶尔收到的那些小短信维持着。

sentences.en: When you sleep with each other like every now and again, when you still get that, you know, Instagram DM from them
sentences.zh: 当你偶尔和对方发生关系，当你依然收到他们的Instagram私信时，

sentences.en: and like your attention is immediately grabbed and you're immediately feeling like loved and wanted again.
sentences.zh: 你的注意力立刻被吸引，你立刻又感觉被爱、被需要了。

sentences.en: All of that, all of those kind of small moments in which we are yet to completely break off contact with somebody
sentences.zh: 所有这些，所有那些我们尚未完全与某人断绝联系的小瞬间，

sentences.en: where they're still in our lives, that is keeping us hooked on them.
sentences.zh: 当他们依然在我们的生活中时，这让我们对他们上瘾。

sentences.en: It is what we call unpredictable reward.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们所说的“不可预测的奖励”。

sentences.en: We don't know when we're going to get it, but by keeping those communication and contact channels and pathways open,
sentences.zh: 我们不知道什么时候会得到它，但通过保持这些沟通和联系渠道与路径的开放，

sentences.en: we still expect that we're going to get something from that person, that there could come a time when they will, you know, light us up again,
sentences.zh: 我们依然期待着能从那个人身上得到什么，期待着会有那么一刻，他们会，你知道，再次点亮我们，

sentences.en: when we will get their affection, when they will want to speak to us.
sentences.zh: 我们会得到他们的爱，他们会想和我们说话。

sentences.en: And so all of that emotion, all of that connection and attachment, although on a rational and very self-aware level, we know the relationship is over,
sentences.zh: 所以所有那些情感、所有那些联系和依恋，尽管在理性和自我意识层面，我们知道关系已经结束了，

sentences.en: by continuing to put ourselves in situations where that person is still in our life, even in a small capacity, we are not letting our brain recover.
sentences.zh: 但通过继续让自己处于那种人依然在生活中的境地，哪怕只是很小的程度，我们都没有让大脑恢复。

sentences.en: And so no contact is really the solution here because it firstly stops temptation, but it also acts as a complete detox.
sentences.zh: 所以断联确实是这里的解决方案，因为它首先阻止了诱惑，但也起到了一种彻底排毒的作用。

sentences.en: It's very much a cold turkey move.
sentences.zh: 这非常像是一种“冷火鸡”式的戒断（指突然彻底停止）。

sentences.en: I like this concept of a detox a lot when explaining this because that is essentially what is happening.
sentences.zh: 在解释这一点时，我非常喜欢“排毒”这个概念，因为这本质上就是正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: This process of going no contact is a process of removing something from your mind, from your life, from your body that you no longer want present.
sentences.zh: 这种断联的过程，是一个从你的思想、生活、身体中移除你不再希望存在的东西的过程。

sentences.en: It is this purifying, cleansing process of really detoxing your life of this person and hopefully coming out cleaner, coming out better, coming out happier.
sentences.zh: 这是一个净化、清洁的过程，真正把你生活中的这个人排毒出去，希望你能变得更纯净、更好、更快乐。

sentences.en: You are physically removing this person from your life, right?
sentences.zh: 你是在物理上把这个人从你的生活中移除，对吧？

sentences.en: By removing opportunities for them to stay in touch with you and for you to stay in touch with them.
sentences.zh: 通过消除他们与你保持联系以及你与他们保持联系的机会。

sentences.en: But you're also essentially getting used to the fact that you can feel good and you can feel happy and you can have intimate, loving feelings without them.
sentences.zh: 但你本质上也在习惯这样一个事实：没有他们，你依然可以感觉良好，依然可以感到快乐，依然可以拥有亲密、充满爱的感觉。

sentences.en: It also stops the yo-yoing, the back and forth that keeps you hung up.
sentences.zh: 它也阻止了那种让你无法自拔的“溜溜球”式的反复横跳。

sentences.en: It stops the confusion and it lets the cycle break.
sentences.zh: 它阻止了困惑，让循环得以打破。

sentences.en: Like I just said, it means that where previously you were seeking out all of those positive feelings and emotions and reactions from this person.
sentences.zh: 就像我刚才说的，这意味着，以前你一直在从这个人身上寻求所有那些积极的感觉、情绪和反应。

sentences.en: No contact means that you have no other option but to find these necessities somewhere else.
sentences.zh: 断联意味着你别无选择，只能在其他地方寻找这些必需品。

sentences.en: Hopefully in yourself first, but then eventually in other people.
sentences.zh: 希望首先是在你自己身上，然后最终在其他人身上。

sentences.en: Maybe eventually in a better partner.
sentences.zh: 也许最终是在一个更好的伴侣身上。

sentences.en: Making space like that, getting clear on the fact that holding on to this person is not what is best for you, I think really allows you to let peace into your life
sentences.zh: 腾出这样的空间，明确意识到紧抓着这个人并不是对你最好的选择，我认为这真的能让你把平静带入生活，

sentences.en: and to get control back over that situation and back over the kind of reactions and emotional reactions in particular that you can't stop yourself from having.
sentences.zh: 并重新掌控那种局面，重新掌控那些你无法阻止自己产生的反应，尤其是情绪反应。

sentences.en: You can't stop yourself from wanting this person.
sentences.zh: 你无法阻止自己想要这个人。

sentences.en: You can't undo the past, but you can control how you react to those circumstances and how much access this person continues to have and how much access you give yourself to them.
sentences.zh: 你无法改变过去，但你可以控制你对这些情况的反应，控制这个人继续拥有的权限，以及你给予他们多少接触你的机会。

sentences.en: So I think at the end of the day, like the main reason why no contact works
sentences.zh: 所以我认为归根结底，断联之所以有效的主要原因

sentences.en: is because it breaks the neurological cycle of attachment, but it also stops you from being confused.
sentences.zh: 是因为它打破了依恋的神经循环，但也阻止了你的困惑。

sentences.en: It rids you of the temptation of going back to this person who you cannot be with for whatever reason and it lets you be kind of undistracted and undeterred.
sentences.zh: 它让你摆脱了回到这个无论出于何种原因都无法在一起的人身边的诱惑，让你能够不受干扰、不被动摇。

sentences.en: It doesn't mean that you just continually elongate the detachment and the breakup process just because it is easier to do it slower,
sentences.zh: 这并不意味着你仅仅是因为觉得慢慢来更容易，就不断地拉长疏离和分手的过程，

sentences.en: but it means that it lasts longer and that eventually there will come a time where you do have to accept that your relationship is not what it once was and it is time to move on.
sentences.zh: 而是意味着这个过程会持续更久，最终总会有一个时刻，你必须接受这段关系已不复从前，是时候继续前行了。

sentences.en: So that is essentially my reasoning for why this is such an effective method.
sentences.zh: 所以，这就是我为什么认为这是一种如此有效的方法的根本原因。

sentences.en: But how do we do it successfully?
sentences.zh: 但我们该如何成功做到这一点呢？

sentences.en: How do we stay strong and committed despite all of the things in us, all of the mental compulsions to reach out,
sentences.zh: 尽管我们内心有各种冲动，有各种想要联系对方的心理强迫，我们该如何保持坚定和承诺呢？

sentences.en: all of the desires to have this person back in our lives in some capacity?
sentences.zh: 尽管我们内心有各种渴望，想要以某种方式让这个人回到我们的生活中？

sentences.en: Well, we are going to talk about all of that and more after this short break.
sentences.zh: 好吧，在短暂的休息之后，我们将讨论所有这些以及更多内容。

sentences.en: I've been really trying to prioritize my health in a realistic way this year and something that has kept me really motivated is my WHOOP.
sentences.zh: 今年我一直在以一种现实的方式优先考虑我的健康，而让我保持动力的东西就是我的 WHOOP。

sentences.en: I am such a data person, which is why I love WHOOP, because I can genuinely see why my body feels differently depending on the day,
sentences.zh: 我是一个非常看重数据的人，这就是我喜欢 WHOOP 的原因，因为我可以真切地看到为什么我的身体在不同日子里会有不同的感觉，

sentences.en: why I'm running differently, why I'm maybe less focused.
sentences.zh: 为什么我跑步的状态不同，为什么我有时专注力下降。

sentences.en: WHOOP effortlessly tracks my sleep, it tracks my strain, my recovery, my stress, and most importantly, my overall health.
sentences.zh: WHOOP 可以轻松追踪我的睡眠、身体压力、恢复情况、心理压力，最重要的是，我的整体健康状况。

sentences.en: And it just gives me all that data and all those patterns so I can make better decisions, which includes knowing when to go easy and knowing when to go hard.
sentences.zh: 它为我提供了所有这些数据和模式，让我能够做出更好的决策，包括知道什么时候该放松，什么时候该努力。

sentences.en: New members can try WHOOP with a 30-day free trial before committing to a membership.
sentences.zh: 新用户可以在订阅会员之前，通过 30 天免费试用体验 WHOOP。

sentences.en: That's join.whoop.com slash psychology for your free month of WHOOP.
sentences.zh: 访问 join.whoop.com/psychology 即可获得一个月的免费 WHOOP 体验。

sentences.zh: 有什么珍贵的物品是你永远不会扔掉的吗？

sentences.en: A movie ticket, a boarding pass, or maybe something that makes no sense to anyone but you.
sentences.zh: 一张电影票、一张登机牌，或者可能是某种对别人来说毫无意义，但对你却意义非凡的东西。

sentences.en: In the new podcast Charmed with Sam Todd,
sentences.zh: 在新的播客节目《Charmed with Sam Todd》中，

sentences.en: Sam explores the memories, obsessions, and tiny treasures that become part of who you are.
sentences.zh: Sam 探索了那些成为你生命一部分的记忆、执念和微小的珍宝。

sentences.en: Charmed is warm, it's funny, it's nostalgic, and just full of the little moments and memories that make life matter.
sentences.zh: 《Charmed》温暖、幽默、怀旧，充满了让生活变得有意义的点滴瞬间和回忆。

sentences.en: Charmed with Sam Todd.
sentences.zh: 很高兴认识萨姆·托德。

sentences.en: Stories worn to tell with Pandora.
sentences.zh: Pandora，讲述那些值得铭记的故事。

sentences.en: Listen now on iHeart.
sentences.zh: 现在就在 iHeart 上收听吧。

sentences.en: So, I think I've given you my most compelling argument for why you should go no contact,
sentences.zh: 所以，我想我已经给出了我最有力的论据，说明你为什么要进行“断联”，

sentences.en: especially with an ex, and some of the reasons and the science and the psychology that tells us why it works.
sentences.zh: 尤其是对于前任，以及一些支持它为何有效的原因、科学依据和心理学解释。

sentences.en: But I think just saying it doesn't make it easy.
sentences.zh: 但我认为仅仅说说并不容易做到。

sentences.en: A few years ago, I was seeing this person pretty casually for like four months, but they had a really like significant emotional impact on me,
sentences.zh: 几年前，我曾和一个约会了大约四个月的人保持着相当随意的关系，但他们确实对我产生了非常重大的情感影响，

sentences.en: I think just because of the timing and everything that I was going through.
sentences.zh: 我想这仅仅是因为当时的时间点以及我所经历的一切。

sentences.en: And they were also just not somebody that I should have had in my life.
sentences.zh: 而且他们也不是我生活中应该出现的人。

sentences.en: They were not a kind person.
sentences.zh: 他们并不是一个善良的人。

sentences.en: And I eventually realized that it was a pretty terrible situation.
sentences.zh: 我最终意识到那是一个相当糟糕的处境。

sentences.en: I needed to cut him off.
sentences.zh: 我需要切断与他的联系。

sentences.en: But the number of times I blocked and deleted his number and then would unblock him or would reply to his messages on Instagram, wherever,
sentences.zh: 但我拉黑并删除他的号码，然后又解除拉黑，或者回复他在 Instagram 等任何地方发来的消息的次数，

sentences.en: you would have thought that nothing had changed.
sentences.zh: 你可能会以为一切都没有改变。

sentences.en: And it took me, I think, two to three whole months to really finally quit that situation and to really go cold turkey.
sentences.zh: 我想我花了整整两到三个月的时间才真正彻底结束那种处境，真正做到完全断联。

sentences.en: So, that is just one of the situations where I've really applied this rule.
sentences.zh: 所以，这只是我真正应用这条规则的情况之一。

sentences.en: So, obviously not very well, but I do have some advice that I've learned from my failures, I guess.
sentences.zh: 显然做得不是很好，但我确实从我的失败中总结出了一些建议，我想是这样。

sentences.en: Not my failures.
sentences.zh: 不是失败。

sentences.en: I have some advice that I've learned from my missteps and from my learning experience.
sentences.zh: 我从我的失误和学习经历中总结出了一些建议。

sentences.en: So, here are five, I think, of my best tips and principles for successful no contact.
sentences.zh: 所以，这里有五个我认为对于成功断联最好的建议和原则。

sentences.en: Firstly, try just 21 days of no contact first, straight after a breakup before going all in.
sentences.zh: 首先，在分手后，先尝试 21 天的断联，然后再决定是否彻底执行。

sentences.en: I think this gives us an adjustment period to really reflect on what we want going forward.
sentences.zh: 我认为这给了我们一个调整期，让我们真正反思未来想要什么。

sentences.en: And just taking that three weeks to get an immediate distance to really process our emotions.
sentences.zh: 仅仅花那三周时间来获得即时的距离感，去真正处理我们的情绪。

sentences.en: I think it's also important because it gives us space before we do something impulsive that we'll regret.
sentences.zh: 我认为这也很重要，因为它在我们做出冲动且会后悔的事情之前给了我们空间。

sentences.en: Sometimes, you know, when we're in that highly emotional and volatile state, sometimes, you know, we don't always do what is right.
sentences.zh: 有时，你知道，当我们处于那种高度情绪化和不稳定的状态时，有时，你知道，我们并不总是做正确的事。

sentences.en: Sometimes, we are not able to put in the boundaries that we know what we are going to need later on.
sentences.zh: 有时，我们无法设定我们知道以后会需要的界限。

sentences.en: Sometimes, it is messy and confusing and we get back together with them and then we break up with them again.
sentences.zh: 有时，情况会变得混乱和困惑，我们又复合了，然后又再次分手。

sentences.en: Giving yourself that three weeks of distance straight after an incredibly emotionally intense situation lets you get clear.
sentences.zh: 在极度强烈的情绪状况之后，给自己三周的距离，让你能够清醒过来。

sentences.en: And for practical reasons, right, like it's only three weeks, you guys can come back together and have a conversation.
sentences.zh: 而且从实际原因来看，对吧，反正只有三周，你们之后还可以再见面谈谈。

sentences.en: You might have like items or things to give back, ground rules to apply.
sentences.zh: 你们可能还有一些物品或东西要归还，或者需要设定一些基本规则。

sentences.en: But you've still given yourself like a bit of a head start and you can still see that, you know, you can live without them.
sentences.zh: 但你已经给了自己一点领先优势，你仍然可以看到，你知道，没有他们你也能活下去。

sentences.en: You did that three weeks.
sentences.zh: 你做到了那三周。

sentences.en: You can do another three weeks.
sentences.zh: 你还可以再做三周。

sentences.en: You have breathing room and you have, yeah, I guess,
sentences.zh: 你有喘息的空间，而且你有，是的，我想，

sentences.en: practice and skill to see that this is important and to see that you can live on your own and you can live without that connection.
sentences.zh: 练习和技能来认识到这一点很重要，并认识到你可以独自生活，没有那种联系你也能活下去。

sentences.en: Secondly, treat no contact as a challenge.
sentences.zh: 其次，把断联当作一种挑战。

sentences.en: And when you are really struggling, as we all do, just go for one more hour.
sentences.zh: 当你真的感到挣扎时，就像我们所有人都会经历的那样，就再坚持一小时。

sentences.en: Go for one more minute, even when it's really hard.
sentences.zh: 再坚持一分钟，即使在最困难的时候。

sentences.en: I think that saying goes, it's something like you can do, you can do anything for 30 seconds.
sentences.zh: 我想那句谚语是这么说的，大概是你可以做任何事坚持 30 秒。

sentences.en: When that temptation to reach out to them is really overpowering,
sentences.zh: 当那种想要联系他们的诱惑真的无法抗拒时，

sentences.en: just focus on the 30 seconds in front of you and then the next 30 and then the next 30 before like the craving and the urge dissipates.
sentences.zh: 只需专注于眼前的 30 秒，然后是下一个 30 秒，再下一个 30 秒，直到那种渴望和冲动消散。

sentences.en: The other piece of advice I have that's related to this is to download a sobriety app.
sentences.zh: 我关于这个问题的另一个建议是下载一个戒瘾应用程序。

sentences.en: Now, I know this sounds so strange, but there are apps out there that track your progress when it comes to quitting alcohol, quitting drugs, quitting substances.
sentences.zh: 现在，我知道这听起来很奇怪，但市面上确实有一些应用程序可以追踪你在戒酒、戒毒、戒除物质依赖方面的进展。

sentences.en: We can also use that for people.
sentences.zh: 我们也可以把它用在人际关系上。

sentences.en: It keeps you focused on the time you've already put into removing yourself.
sentences.zh: 它让你专注于你已经投入的时间来让自己脱离那种关系。

sentences.en: It keeps you focused on the progress that you are making that you don't want to undo in a moment of weakness.
sentences.zh: 它让你专注于你正在取得的进展，而你不想在软弱的时刻前功尽弃。

sentences.en: And it really, I think, makes it feel more like a challenge than a chore eventually as well.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，这最终会让它感觉更像是一种挑战，而不是一种苦差事。

sentences.en: Speaking from experience, it's something that you just don't even check.
sentences.zh: 以我的经验来说，这甚至是你根本不会去查看的东西。

sentences.en: You don't even care.
sentences.zh: 你甚至不在乎了。

sentences.en: And I think that moment when you're like, oh, I'm not looking at the minutes that we spent apart ticking by.
sentences.zh: 我想当你发现自己不再盯着我们分开的分钟数流逝时，

sentences.en: I'm not looking at the hours we haven't spoken, you know, floating into the ether.
sentences.zh: 不再盯着我们没有说话的小时数，你知道，消失在虚无中，

sentences.en: I don't care anymore.
sentences.zh: 我不在乎了。

sentences.en: That is when you know that you've healed.
sentences.zh: 那就是你知道你已经痊愈的时候。

sentences.en: I know that right now the possibility of that reality, the possibility of no longer even caring about what that person is doing or who they're with, you know,
sentences.zh: 我知道现在那种现实的可能性，那种不再关心那个人在做什么或和谁在一起的可能性，你知道，

sentences.en: no longer being able to hear from them or touch them.
sentences.zh: 不再能听到他们的消息或触碰他们。

sentences.en: Right now, that reality seems really devastating.
sentences.zh: 现在，那种现实看起来真的很令人崩溃。

sentences.en: But I think with time, that sting will lessen.
sentences.zh: 但我认为随着时间的推移，那种刺痛感会减轻。

sentences.en: That doesn't necessarily mean that this process will be linear.
sentences.zh: 这并不一定意味着这个过程是线性的。

sentences.en: I think for anybody who has, you know, been through a breakup, been through a friendship breakup or a family estrangement, process is not linear.
sentences.zh: 我想对于任何经历过分手、友谊破裂或家庭疏远的人来说，这个过程都不是线性的。

sentences.en: Each day, it's not promised that it's going to be better than the laSt.
sentences.zh: 每一天，并不保证都会比前一天更好。

sentences.en: I think that's a fact of life is that grief does not know any timeline but its own.
sentences.zh: 我认为生活的一个事实是，悲伤没有时间表，它只遵循自己的节奏。

sentences.en: However, I want you to remember that it is totally normal for that to be the case.
sentences.zh: 然而，我希望你记住，这种情况是完全正常的。

sentences.en: It is totally normal to have a few weeks where you feel amazing and you feel great and then just a day of just despair and grief and tears, even when you've been doing so well.
sentences.zh: 有几周感觉很棒，感觉很好，然后突然有一天陷入绝望、悲伤和泪水中，即使你一直做得很好，这也是完全正常的。

sentences.en: So this brings me to my next tip.
sentences.zh: 所以这引出了我的下一个建议。

sentences.en: Don't be afraid of memory flare-ups and don't let them undo your progress.
sentences.zh: 不要害怕记忆的突然闪回，也不要让它们毁掉你的进展。

sentences.en: Just because you're still thinking about them after going no contact doesn't mean you are failing and it definitely doesn't mean it's not working.
sentences.zh: 仅仅因为你在断联后仍然想着他们，并不意味着你失败了，也绝对不意味着它没有效果。

sentences.en: Just because you find yourself fantasizing or daydreaming about the past doesn't mean that you should revisit it.
sentences.zh: 仅仅因为你发现自己在幻想或做关于过去的白日梦，并不意味着你应该重温它。

sentences.en: I want you to remember that.
sentences.zh: 我希望你记住这一点。

sentences.en: I think we all know that feeling of having like an eerily weird dream about an ex and thinking that there is some deeper meaning, but there isn't.
sentences.zh: 我想我们都知道那种做了一个关于前任的诡异梦，并认为其中有什么深层含义的感觉，但其实并没有。

sentences.en: This is just your brain processing information and processing important memories.
sentences.zh: 这只是你的大脑在处理信息和重要的记忆。

sentences.en: So there's a concept that I like to bring up when people talk to me about this.
sentences.zh: 所以，当人们和我谈论这个时，我喜欢提出一个概念。

sentences.en: You know, I had someone actually message me the other day and she was like, you know,
sentences.zh: 你知道，前几天确实有人给我发消息，她说，你知道，

sentences.en: it's been eight months since I've gone no contact and I've just randomly in the last couple of weeks, I cannot stop reliving things.
sentences.zh: 我已经断联八个月了，但在过去几周里，我随机地无法停止重温过去的事情。

sentences.en: I cannot stop thinking about her.
sentences.zh: 我无法停止想她。

sentences.en: So this is a phenomenon known as mind pops and it's super strange.
sentences.zh: 这是一种被称为“思维跳跃”（mind pops）的现象，非常奇怪。

sentences.en: Essentially what happens is that you'll be going about your day, you're feeling amazing,
sentences.zh: 本质上发生的事情是，你正在过着你的一天，感觉很棒，

sentences.en: and then this random memory or image will suddenly pop into your head for no specific reason, almost like a flashback.
sentences.zh: 然后这个随机的记忆或图像会突然毫无缘由地跳进你的脑海，几乎就像闪回一样。

sentences.en: Now there was an article written about this almost 10, oh my gosh, 12 years ago, it was written in 2012.
sentences.zh: 现在，有一篇关于这个的文章是在几乎 10 年，天哪，12 年前写的，它是 2012 年写的。

sentences.en: So it was written by Scientific America.
sentences.zh: 是由《科学美国人》撰写的。

sentences.en: And the reason that this happens is not because, you know, it's a sign that somebody else is thinking about you.
sentences.zh: 发生这种情况的原因并不是因为，你知道，这是别人在想你的迹象。

sentences.en: It's not because your brain knows something that you don't or that it's fate or destiny.
sentences.zh: 也不是因为你的大脑知道一些你不知道的事情，或者这是缘分或命运。

sentences.en: It's actually just a part of our brain kind of cleaning out the filing cabinet.
sentences.zh: 这实际上只是我们大脑在清理文件柜的一部分。

sentences.en: It's part of our brain just filtering through our semantic or autobiographical memories as it needs to do.
sentences.zh: 这是我们大脑在根据需要过滤我们的语义或自传体记忆的一部分。

sentences.en: You know, our brains are constantly working and going and they're shooting energy and impulses across millions of neural connections.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们的大脑一直在工作和运转，它们在数百万个神经连接中发射能量和脉冲。

sentences.en: Sometimes it's, you know, these connections, sometimes these electrical impulses are going to accidentally take the wrong road and they're going to revisit something unexpected.
sentences.zh: 有时，你知道，这些连接，有时这些电脉冲会意外地走错路，它们会重温一些意想不到的事情。

sentences.en: That is normal.
sentences.zh: 这是正常的。

sentences.en: It's also a lot more common around, like, significant dates.
sentences.zh: 在重要的日期前后，这种情况也更常见。

sentences.en: So if it's a birthday or Valentine's Day or a former anniversary, it's also all the more common in what we know as the anniversary effect.
sentences.zh: 所以如果是生日、情人节或以前的纪念日，在所谓的“周年纪念效应”中，这种情况也更为常见。

sentences.en: So our recollection of painful or hard memories, our sense of longing, it does typically increase around significant dates and significant moments.
sentences.zh: 所以我们对痛苦或艰难记忆的回忆，我们的渴望感，通常会在重要的日子和重要的时刻增加。

sentences.en: I think this is especially the case like around Christmas is one that people talk to me about or around birthdays where you're like,
sentences.zh: 我认为这在圣诞节前后尤其明显，这是人们常和我谈论的，或者在生日前后，你会觉得，

sentences.en: oh, last year I was with this person and I felt really, really loved and this year I'm not.
sentences.zh: 哦，去年我和这个人在一起，我感到非常非常被爱，而今年我没有。

sentences.en: And it just brings back a lot of the pain.
sentences.zh: 这只会带回很多痛苦。

sentences.en: I don't want you to see that as a reason that you are failing.
sentences.zh: 我不希望你把这看作是你失败的理由。

sentences.en: I don't want you to think that that means you're losing progress.
sentences.zh: 我不希望你认为这意味着你在失去进展。

sentences.en: It is actually a super, super, super normal part of this journey.
sentences.zh: 这实际上是这段旅程中一个非常、非常、非常正常的部分。

sentences.en: I really promise you.
sentences.zh: 我真的向你保证。

sentences.en: So my fourth tip is to share with your friends.
sentences.zh: 所以我的第四个建议是与你的朋友分享。

sentences.en: Share your commitment to go no contact or to maintain your no contact with people around you who you truSt.
sentences.zh: 与你信任的人分享你断联的承诺，或者与你信任的人保持断联。

sentences.en: And who you know care about you because they will help you stay accountable.
sentences.zh: 而且你知道他们关心你，因为他们会帮助你保持责任感。

sentences.en: This is kind of a rule of thumb.
sentences.zh: 这算是一个经验法则。

sentences.en: If you wouldn't tell your friends about something.
sentences.zh: 如果你不会告诉你的朋友某件事。

sentences.en: So if you wouldn't tell them that you've, you know, cheekily replied to somebody's story or that you, you know, emailed them or that you had an accidental run in with them.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你不会告诉他们你，你知道，偷偷回复了某人的动态，或者你，你知道，给他们发了邮件，或者你偶然遇到了他们。

sentences.en: Like if you wouldn't tell them that, it's probably not the thing that you should be doing.
sentences.zh: 就像如果你不会告诉他们那样，这可能不是你应该做的事情。

sentences.en: It is probably the wrong decision.
sentences.zh: 这很可能是错误的决定。

sentences.en: So when you do have those urges to reach out because we will have them, text and talk to your friends instead.
sentences.zh: 所以当你确实有那些想要联系的冲动时，因为我们都会有，那就去给你的朋友发短信或交谈吧。

sentences.en: So I had a friend who actually changed my name in her phone to her ex's name when she wanted to text him.
sentences.zh: 我有一个朋友，当她想给前任发短信时，她实际上把手机里的名字改成了她前任的名字。

sentences.en: And she would like message me all the things that she would want to say.
sentences.zh: 然后她会把所有她想说的话发消息给我。

sentences.en: Like, I'm so upset that you hurt me.
sentences.zh: 比如，你伤害了我，我很难过。

sentences.en: You've really let me down.
sentences.zh: 你真的让我失望了。

sentences.en: But I want to give you another chance.
sentences.zh: 但我还是想给你一次机会。

sentences.en: She would send that to me.
sentences.zh: 她会把这些发给我。

sentences.en: And I would like reply as him and be super rational.
sentences.zh: 我会以他的身份回复，表现得非常理性。

sentences.en: And I would say what I knew she needed to hear.
sentences.zh: 我会说出我知道她需要听到的话。

sentences.en: Not what she wanted to hear.
sentences.zh: 而不是她想听到的话。

sentences.en: But what if I imagine what he would say that would convince her that that was a bad decision.
sentences.zh: 而是如果我设想他会说什么，能让她相信那是一个糟糕的决定。

sentences.en: And it worked.
sentences.zh: 结果奏效了。

sentences.en: It sounds super bizarre, but it worked.
sentences.zh: 这听起来超级离谱，但它奏效了。

sentences.en: Community, I think, is also just a valuable antidote to the general loneliness we may experience.
sentences.zh: 我认为社区也是我们可能经历的普遍孤独感的一种宝贵解药。

sentences.en: When we are so used to talking to our ex, it is a compulsion, it is a habit, it can feel like a hole has been left in our life.
sentences.zh: 当我们习惯了和前任交谈时，这是一种强迫，是一种习惯，它会让人感觉生活中留下了一个空洞。

sentences.en: Who are we going to share our everyday thoughts with?
sentences.zh: 我们要和谁分享我们日常的想法呢？

sentences.en: Who are we going to, you know, share our successes and our failures with?
sentences.zh: 我们要和谁，你知道，分享我们的成功和失败呢？

sentences.en: Who's going to celebrate us?
sentences.zh: 谁会为我们庆祝呢？

sentences.en: Who is going to care about that small thing that, you know, we saw on the bus or that happened at work?
sentences.zh: 谁会关心我们在公交车上看到的或在工作中发生的那件小事呢？

sentences.en: Your friends will.
sentences.zh: 你的朋友会。

sentences.en: Tell them.
sentences.zh: 告诉他们。

sentences.en: They want to hear from you.
sentences.zh: 他们想听你倾诉。

sentences.en: That is a way of making your relationship as strong as the one that you shared with this other person.
sentences.zh: 这是一种让你的友谊像你与那个人分享的关系一样强大的方式。

sentences.en: Communication and vulnerability and letting them help you.
sentences.zh: 沟通、脆弱，并让他们帮助你。

sentences.en: Finally, my final tip for making no contact work.
sentences.zh: 最后，我关于让断联生效的最后一个建议。

sentences.en: Make the fortress impenetrable.
sentences.zh: 让堡垒变得坚不可摧。

sentences.en: Leave no passage unblocked.
sentences.zh: 不要留下任何未被封锁的通道。

sentences.en: There is no way for them to get in.
sentences.zh: 他们根本进不来。

sentences.en: Because if you leave a secret door open that only you know about, you are giving yourself the option to reach back out.
sentences.zh: 因为如果你留了一扇只有你自己知道的暗门，你其实是在给自己留后路。

sentences.en: You are creating also the false promise that if they wanted to get in touch with you, they could.
sentences.zh: 你同时也制造了一个虚假的希望，好像如果他们想联系你，他们就能联系上。

sentences.en: And that is not the commitment that we are looking for.
sentences.zh: 而这并不是我们所追求的那种决心。

sentences.en: That is not being in 100%.
sentences.zh: 那不是百分之百的投入。

sentences.en: Instagram, Facebook, email, text, cut them all off.
sentences.zh: Instagram、Facebook、电子邮件、短信，把这些联系方式全部切断。

sentences.en: And if they do somehow find a way to reach out to you, have something prepared to say.
sentences.zh: 如果他们真的想方设法联系到了你，要提前准备好应对的话术。

sentences.en: So I'm going to quote this article by the coach Matthew Hussey because I love what he had to say about this in a recent article.
sentences.zh: 我想引用教练 Matthew Hussey 的一篇文章，因为我很喜欢他在最近一篇文章中对此的看法。

sentences.en: When somebody reaches back out, I think that is the time that it is the hardest because it's like they're right there.
sentences.zh: 当有人再次联系你时，我认为那是这一过程中最艰难的时刻，因为他们就像近在咫尺。

sentences.en: It's like putting a bowl of candy in front of a kid and saying, don't touch it, even though that's all they want to do.
sentences.zh: 这就像把一碗糖果放在孩子面前，告诉他不要碰，尽管那是他唯一想做的事。

sentences.en: That is all you want to do right now.
sentences.zh: 而这正是你现在唯一想做的事。

sentences.en: Now,
sentences.zh: 现在，

sentences.en: the thing you most want in the world is to hear from that person because hearing from them is going to reignite so much that you actually did enjoy and that you are nostalgic about when it comes to your relationship.
sentences.zh: 你在这个世界上最渴望的就是听到那个人的消息，因为听到他们的声音会重新点燃许多你曾经享受过的、关于这段关系的怀旧之情。

sentences.en: So it is very much like reopening an old wound.
sentences.zh: 所以这非常像是在揭开旧伤疤。

sentences.en: And then I think it just sets it's just like a domino effect.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为这会产生一种多米诺骨牌效应。

sentences.en: Once you reply to one message being like, yeah, hey, how are you?
sentences.zh: 一旦你回复了一条消息，比如“嘿，你好吗？”

sentences.en: Instead of just ignoring it or instead of being like, hi, actually, I'm not looking to have any further communication with you.
sentences.zh: 而不是直接无视，或者说“嗨，其实我不想再和你进行任何沟通了”。

sentences.en: If you don't do that immediately, it snowballs.
sentences.zh: 如果你不立即这样做，事情就会像滚雪球一样失控。

sentences.en: It might just be a few messages.
sentences.zh: 可能只是几条消息。

sentences.en: It might last an entire day.
sentences.zh: 可能持续一整天。

sentences.en: It might be the rekindling of a relationship that you already know was not meant to be.
sentences.zh: 甚至可能重燃一段你明知注定没有结果的关系。

sentences.en: So have something planned that you are going to say in response to those situations.
sentences.zh: 所以，要提前规划好你在面对这些情况时要说的话。

sentences.en: Find something, a specific affirmation or a mantra or whatever, some kind of motivation that's going to keep you focused on why this is important.
sentences.zh: 找一些特定的肯定语、咒语，或者任何能让你专注于这件事重要性的动力。

sentences.en: Why you wanted to do this in the first place.
sentences.zh: 想想你最初为什么想这么做。

sentences.en: Maybe it is, you know, I don't want to have contact with this person because I know that by doing that, I will leave space for somebody better to come into my life.
sentences.zh: 也许是因为，你知道，我不想和这个人有联系，因为我知道这样做，我才能为更好的人进入我的生活腾出空间。

sentences.en: Maybe it is, you know, eventually this relationship is going to have to fade.
sentences.zh: 也许是因为，你知道，这段关系终究会淡去。

sentences.en: I would rather it starts now than in three months, six months, a year.
sentences.zh: 我宁愿它现在就开始，而不是在三个月、六个月或一年后。

sentences.en: Whatever it is that is keeping you motivated, stay on it.
sentences.zh: 无论是什么在激励着你，坚持下去。

sentences.en: Stay focused.
sentences.zh: 保持专注。

sentences.en: Stay focused.
sentences.zh: 保持专注。

sentences.en: I'm sending you so much love and strength because I know this is really hard.
sentences.zh: 我为你送上满满的爱与力量，因为我知道这真的很难。

sentences.en: This person probably meant so much to you.
sentences.zh: 这个人对你来说可能意义重大。

sentences.en: They probably were somebody that you really cared about.
sentences.zh: 他们可能曾是你真心在乎的人。

sentences.en: And nobody goes into the start of a relationship with anybody, romantic, platonic, anything, imagining the ending.
sentences.zh: 没有人会在开始一段关系——无论是浪漫的、柏拉图式的还是任何关系——的时候，就去想象它的结局。

sentences.en: And so when we do find ourselves there, it just seems that any way to cope is something that we have to try.
sentences.zh: 所以当我们真的走到这一步时，似乎任何应对的方法我们都必须尝试。

sentences.en: And I do think that this is one of the better ways.
sentences.zh: 而我确实认为这是更好的方法之一。

sentences.en: This is one of the healthier, more sustainable ways of finding peace, finding closure, taking your life back for yourself.
sentences.zh: 这是寻找平静、达成和解、夺回生活主导权的最健康、最可持续的方法之一。

sentences.en: So there is not that cloud lingering over your head of what if or what next or is there a future for us?
sentences.zh: 这样你就不会再被“如果当初”或“接下来会怎样”或“我们还有未来吗”这样的阴云笼罩。

sentences.en: You have closed that door for good, for good.
sentences.zh: 你已经彻底关上了那扇门，彻底地。

sentences.en: You're not opening it again.
sentences.zh: 你不会再打开它了。

sentences.en: As hard as that might be, it will get easier.
sentences.zh: 尽管这可能很难，但情况会好转的。

sentences.en: I promise you it will get easier and you will find somebody better and you will find somebody who you never have to consider this possibility with.
sentences.zh: 我向你保证，一切都会好起来的，你会找到更好的人，你会找到一个让你永远不必考虑这种可能的人。

sentences.en: So thank you so much for listening to today's episode.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢大家收听今天的节目。

sentences.en: I really do hope that you enjoyed and I'm sure that if you've listened this far, you're probably really going through it right now.
sentences.zh: 我真心希望你们喜欢，而且我相信，如果你听到了这里，你现在可能真的正处于艰难时刻。

sentences.en: So I really, really empathize with you and I sympathize for you.
sentences.zh: 所以我真的、真的很同情你，也理解你的感受。

sentences.en: It is tough.
sentences.zh: 这真的很艰难。

sentences.en: Do not let yourself feel any differently.
sentences.zh: 不要让自己有任何其他的想法。
